purpose: Homework-scale tactical screening, isolated ablations, broader diagnostics and matched-start games.
game_cap_policy: Nonterminal cap is unfinished (*); no invented draw. Report completed score and worst/best censoring bounds.
timing: One timed engine search at a time; independent reference certification outside the search budget. Root screening included in the MCTS budget.

excluded_runs.pilot-capture-draw: Initial capture fixture led to insufficient-material draw, so quiet moves tied its zero terminal score. Added a pawn to make the capture diagnostic uniquely informative, then reran the complete ablation. Pilot is retained locally, excluded from report analysis and ZIP.

limits: Constructed cases and mirrored/repeated seeds are correlated.
No external-engine move rankings or Elo.
Root guard covers immediate mates only.
Material diagnostic evaluates only one opposing reply.
Matched game starts are the same four selected positions at both budgets.
